name: QuickBooks Online (Plus & Advanced)
best_fit: Residential & light commercial service shops ($1M to $15M, single entity, T&M or flat-rate billing)
pricing: Plus: $99/mo (5 users) · Advanced: $235/mo (25 users) · Payroll & payment processing billed separately
wip_and_poc: Manual spreadsheet or journal entry; QBO Projects tracks job profitability but does not auto-calculate POC over/underbilling
aia_and_retainage: Progress invoicing supported (% of estimate); formal AIA G702/G703 & automatic AP/AR retainage require manual workarounds or add-ons
certified_payroll: Not native in core QBO; requires specialized construction payroll integration (e.g., eBacon, Points North, or ADP/Paychex construction)
data_access_and_apis: Intuit REST API + scheduled browser/Excel exports; native connectors for Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, and BuildOps
what_works: Fastest setup for service and replacement contractors. Bank feeds, customer invoicing, basic project profitability, and native app connectors cover daily bookkeeping without ERP overhead.
where_it_breaks: In our ledger audits, QBO General Ledger exports output both the debit and credit leg of every entry. Naive sums double job cost or revenue unless filtered by account type and transaction ID. QBO also lacks native cost-to-cost WIP over/underbilling schedules and multi-entity intercompany eliminations.
demo_script: Ask to see one commercial progress-billed job with 10% customer retainage, a mid-month change order, and a month-end over/underbilling journal entry without exporting to Excel.
hold_condition: You run bonded commercial projects requiring lender/surety WIP schedules, multi-entity intercompany eliminations, or union WH-347 certified payroll out of the box.
documented_capabilities_summary: Project profitability only: Tracks project income and costs; automated over/underbilling WIP schedules require an add-on or spreadsheet. | Progress invoice %: Bills a percentage of an estimate; automated POC revenue-recognition journal entries are not native. | Progress invoicing (non-AIA): Creates milestone or percentage invoices from estimates; official AIA G702/G703 forms require an add-on. | Manual retention item: Requires configuring a negative retainage service item and liability account rather than automated retainage.
verification_question: Show whether the proposed subscription produces a WIP view at your cutoff from the project costs, billings and credits; if any step happens outside the product, name it. Identify the exact edition, report definition and review needed to reproduce that date.

name: Finaloop (Ecommerce & DTC Accounting)
best_fit: Shopify, Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop, Faire & retail POS brands ($1M to $50M) needing real-time COGS & payout reconciliation
pricing: Tiered subscription by annual GMV & modules (real-time inventory COGS, tax prep) · Typically ~$250 to $1,200+/mo
wip_and_poc: Built for physical-goods FIFO/landed-cost COGS and PO inventory tracking rather than construction POC work-in-progress
aia_and_retainage: Native 15-row Shopify Reconciliation Report bridges Finaloop books vs. Shopify Admin across 9 gross-to-net sales columns
certified_payroll: Syncs with Gusto, Rippling, and ADP for corporate/retail payroll; not designed for union WH-347 construction payroll
data_access_and_apis: Browser Report Center (.xlsx/.csv exports for P&L, Balance Sheet, GL, Trial Balance, Shopify Reconciliation) + SKU Analysis & LTV dashboards; no open public REST API for full GL extraction
what_works: Replaces fragile QuickBooks + A2X clearing spreadsheets with direct, order-level sync across Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Walmart, Loop Returns, Stripe, PayPal, and Settle. Tracks landed-cost COGS by SKU and gross-to-net channel margin continuously.
where_it_breaks: In our production ecommerce closes, three reconciliation traps surface repeatedly: (1) uncategorized bank inflows and outflows sit in 'Waiting for your input' queues (/transactions), quarantining six-figure Settle PO advances, bank transfers, or wire payments off the Balance Sheet until categorized; (2) Finaloop's 15-row Shopify Reconciliation Report requires auditing Excluded sales channels, Void/Canceled orders, and Unfulfilled order deferrals; and (3) Settle working-capital loans require linking factory bills to the loan subledger (/loans) and splitting principal vs. financing fees on bank draft.
demo_script: Open the Report Center Shopify Reconciliation Report for a closed month alongside the 'Waiting for your input' transaction queue (/transactions) and the Loans subledger (/loans), and verify that unfulfilled orders, Loop return fees, and Settle PO repayments tie to the penny.
hold_condition: You operate a multi-entity international group requiring automated intercompany eliminations, complex multi-stage in-house manufacturing work orders, or an open REST API for custom ERP data warehousing.
verification_question: Open the Report Center Shopify Reconciliation Report for a closed month alongside the 'Waiting for your input' transaction queue (/transactions) and the Loans subledger (/loans), and verify that unfulfilled orders, Loop return fees, and Settle PO repayments tie to the penny.

name: QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise (Contractor)
best_fit: Single-entity trade & specialty contractors ($3M to $20M) wanting local job-cost reports without a full ERP migration
pricing: Annual subscription (~$1,922 to $4,600+/yr by seat count & tier) · Rightworks cloud hosting adds ~$55 to $75/user/mo
wip_and_poc: Committed-cost and Job WIP summary reports in Contractor Edition; POC over/underbilling journal entries still require accountant review
aia_and_retainage: Progress invoicing by line/phase; retainage receivable/payable tracked via dedicated holding items and accounts
certified_payroll: Basic WH-347 report templates available in Desktop Payroll; complex multi-union fringe tables typically need an add-on
data_access_and_apis: QuickBooks Web Connector (.qwc SOAP XML) or SDK; no native modern cloud REST API without middleware
what_works: Built-in Contractor Edition job-cost reports (Job Profitability Detail, Committed Costs by Job, Unpaid Bills by Job) are significantly stronger out of the box than QBO Plus for single-entity project shops.
where_it_breaks: Cloud field platforms (ServiceTitan, BuildOps, Housecall Pro) sync through QuickBooks Web Connector inside a hosted Windows environment (Rightworks or local RDS). Multi-user mode locks, expired .qwc certificates, or unmapped item codes silently stall invoice and bill batches until an admin clears the queue.
demo_script: Have the vendor push a batch of 25 field invoices and supplier PO bills through Web Connector while two office users are logged into QuickBooks Enterprise.
hold_condition: You want browser-native multi-entity consolidation, real-time REST API connections, or want to eliminate hosted Windows remote-desktop servers.
documented_capabilities_summary: Job WIP summary: Contractor/Enterprise reports show estimate vs. actuals by job; over/underbilling GL adjustments are manual. | Estimate vs. actual %: Progress invoicing bills by % of estimate; automated POC journal entries require accountant entries. | Progress invoice template: Supports progress invoicing by line or phase; official AIA G702/G703 forms require third-party add-ons. | Retention item setup: Tracks withheld retention via dedicated item and sub-account setup; confirm automated release needs.
verification_question: Use the exact Enterprise edition and hosted/local setup in the quote. Show the job-cost and billing reports, the permitted accountant/export handoff and a backup or retained file that can reproduce the same cutoff. This is a demo request, not verified feature support.

name: Sage Intacct Construction
best_fit: Multi-entity commercial HVAC, mechanical, electrical & plumbing groups ($10M to $100M+) scaling with BuildOps or ServiceTitan
pricing: Custom annual contract by entity count, Business vs. Employee users, and modules (typically $25,000 to $65,000+/yr + implementation)
wip_and_poc: Native Construction WIP Management with automated cost-to-cost over/underbilling schedules and GL posting
aia_and_retainage: Native progress billing, customer & subcontractor retainage holds/releases, and commitment change-order tracking
certified_payroll: Supported via Sage Intacct Construction Payroll or certified construction payroll partners
data_access_and_apis: Sage Intacct XML & REST APIs + Custom Report Writer; direct connectors for BuildOps, ServiceTitan, Procore, and Ramp
what_works: Best-in-class dimensional General Ledger (Project, Customer, Location, Department, Cost Code, Cost Type, Vendor) and instant multi-entity consolidation without manual intercompany eliminations.
where_it_breaks: In our production API and browser audits, Top-Level vs. Entity-level queries return different transaction populations when entity-restricted permissions or inter-entity rules are misconfigured. Partial batch imports from field systems can also leave rejected AP bills or AR invoices in subledger draft states while the GL trial balance appears clean.
demo_script: Ask the implementer to post a cross-entity commercial job from BuildOps or ServiceTitan, fail one cost-code mapping on purpose, and show where the rejected line surfaces in Intacct.
hold_condition: Your field team has not standardized cost codes and job phases. Intacct enforces dimensional rigor and rejects unmapped field exports.
documented_capabilities_summary: WIP statement + GL: Construction solution describes automated statements and over/underbilling GL entries. | POC revenue recognition: Automates percentage-of-completion revenue recognition and over/underbilling GL entries. | AIA billing described: Confirm the forms and licensed module for the construction solution. | AR/AP retainage: Construction module manages receivable and payable retainage withholding and release.
verification_question: Use one company entity, not only a consolidated Top Level view. Retain matching GL/TB detail and a native document with all split lines; show the difference between a WIP report, a proposed journal and a verified posting. Ask how partial import results are reviewed before retry.

name: Trimble Viewpoint Spectrum
best_fit: Commercial mechanical, electrical, HVAC & general contractors ($15M to $150M+) with heavy union payroll, AIA billing & WIP
pricing: Custom annual quote via Trimble Construction One subscription bundles
wip_and_poc: Native commercial construction WIP schedule, cost-to-complete forecasting, and automated over/underbilling journal entries
aia_and_retainage: Native AIA G702/G703 progress billing, tiered subcontractor retainage, and lien-waiver compliance holds
certified_payroll: Native multi-union, multi-state prevailing wage and certified payroll (WH-347, LCPtracker, DIR)
data_access_and_apis: Spectrum Data Exchange (SDX) SOAP/web services + browser/Crystal report exports; integrates with BuildOps
what_works: Built from the ground up for commercial trade contractors. Union fringe calculations, certified payroll, subcontract compliance, equipment cost recovery, and cost-to-cost WIP live natively in the core ledger.
where_it_breaks: In our Spectrum data-layer checks, web-service job endpoints (GetJob / GetJobMain) update on a different schedule than posted cost-to-date and payroll batch registers. Pulling active jobs via API can return a current contract header while labor hours and AP bills are still sitting in unposted batch queues.
demo_script: Run a live WIP report alongside the unposted AP and payroll batch register for the same cutoff date, and verify how BuildOps or field timecards reconcile before batch posting.
hold_condition: You are primarily a residential/light-commercial service shop that does not need union payroll, subcontract compliance, or bonded WIP schedules.
documented_capabilities_summary: Work in Progress report: Job Cost module prints WIP schedules with contract, cost, billed and over/underbilled columns. | Percent-complete earned rev: Calculates percent complete and earned revenue from job cost and projected cost-at-completion. | AIA-format draw requests: Help describes two standard AIA formats; confirm required forms. | Line-level retainage: Expanded and Crystal-Link reports print retainage per line; rounding and overrides matter.

name: FOUNDATION Construction Accounting
best_fit: Prevailing-wage, union, civil, electrical & mechanical contractors ($5M to $50M) prioritizing in-house certified payroll & job costing
pricing: Custom quote by concurrent seats and optional modules (Payroll Service, ProjectHQ, Mobile Field Log)
wip_and_poc: Native over/underbilling WIP schedules with percent-complete by cost, units, or project-manager override
aia_and_retainage: Native AIA G702/G703 billing, change-order margin tracking, and automatic AR/AP retainage ledgers
certified_payroll: Industry-standard native WH-347, state-specific electronic certified payroll, and automated union fringe/deduction tables
data_access_and_apis: SQL database reporting + scheduled CSV/flat-file import/export routines; tighter third-party API ecosystem than Intacct
what_works: Eliminates third-party certified-payroll bolt-ons for prevailing-wage and union shops. Every labor hour carries its exact Davis-Bacon rate, union local fringe table, and workers'-comp class directly into job cost.
where_it_breaks: Because FOUNDATION has a more closed API ecosystem than cloud-native ERPs like Intacct or NetSuite, external residential/commercial FSMs often rely on flat-file CSV import templates. demo_script: Ask to see the exact file import and error-handling log between your field dispatch tool and FOUNDATION for 100 technician timecards across two union locals.
hold_condition: You require open REST APIs for custom software automation or multi-subsidiary international/non-construction consolidation.
documented_capabilities_summary: WIP / over-under reports: Job Costing module describes both report types. | Cost-to-cost POC: Calculates percentage of completion from incurred-to-estimated job costs for over/underbilling. | AIA billing described: Accounts Receivable page describes AIA billing; confirm exact forms. | Retainage aging: View aging and retainage by job, customer and project manager.
verification_question: Use the payroll classifications and reporting jurisdiction your actual work requires. Request the earnings-to-certified-report trace plus a job-cost and billing example, then identify any partner step and its cost. A generic payroll demonstration is insufficient.

name: Oracle NetSuite
best_fit: PE-backed multi-location service rollups, omnichannel ecommerce brands, distributor-contractors & inventory-heavy operations ($15M to $200M+)
pricing: Custom annual contract (base platform + user licenses + SuiteApps; typically $35,000 to $90,000+/yr + implementation)
wip_and_poc: Native project accounting, multi-location inventory COGS & Advanced Revenue Management (POC); construction WIP layouts often tailored via SuiteApps/Saved Searches
aia_and_retainage: Standard milestone/progress billing included; formal AIA G702/G703 forms and subcontractor retainage holds typically require a construction SuiteApp
certified_payroll: Not native in core NetSuite ERP; requires a certified-payroll SuiteApp or external construction payroll engine

hold_condition: Your core pain is single-entity DTC ecommerce bookkeeping (where Finaloop or QBO+A2X is faster) or single-entity union construction payroll and AIA billing (where Intacct Construction, Spectrum, or Foundation deliver natively).
